findings.issue: The new `private def squareRelatorGenerator` (297-299) is a verbatim copy of the anonymous matcher inside `generatorsWithSquareRelator` (310-313), and `sourceComm_eq_comm` (Relator.lean:197) / `sourceComm_notSquare` (315) exist only to work around it: they restate `sourceComm`'s definition because `sourceComm` lacks `@[expose]`, which is why `generatorsWithSquareRelator_eq` and `cosetTableColumns` lost their one-line `rfl` proofs.

summary: The Lyons transcription itself is new material with no counterpart in Mathlib or TauCeti, but the shared `Relator.sourceComm` it introduces is only half-adopted: eight sporadic modules keep byte-identical private clones, Thompson retains a pure alias wrapper, and Thompson gains a duplicate copy of its own `filterMap` matcher purely because `sourceComm` was not given `@[expose]` like its siblings `conj`/`div`.
